96241.dialogueBodyHTML:
Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

Use the Toxin Extractor to gather 5 Gloomrise Toxin Samples from the Gnawed Corpses at Gloomrise.
Gloomrise Toxin Sample (5)
Toxin Extractor (Provided) (1)

Description

Something funny be happenin' over there at Gloomrise. Ol' Mazu'kon be hearin all about these nasty new beasties skitterin' all around there. Some say those creepy crawlies got a venom that have some unique properties and this be gettin' me curious. Take my extractor. Use it on the dead bodies layin' around that place to harvest the venom. Do this and I be in ya debt, mon.

Progress

Did ya get what I need?

Completion

Heh... when I said unique properties, I wasn't kiddin' mon! You seem no worse for wear, so it be all good.

Thank you for your aid, <class>. It be much appreciated.

Rewards

You will receive:

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 100 reputation with Darkspear Trolls
  • 100 reputation with Earthen Ring

96259.dialogueBodyHTML:
Defending the Dead

Kill 10 Gloomrise Hatchlings and 5 Gloomrise Soldiers.
  •  
Gloomrise Hatchling slain (10)
  •  
Gloomrise Soldier slain (5)

Description

There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred. It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.

Progress

The spirits of our ancestors need to rest easy, once again.

Completion

Thank you for your service to the people of this land. It may take time for us to completely clear out the infestation, but your efforts have created a stable foothold for us to leverage against these vile creatures.

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 150 reputation with Earthen Ring
  • 100 reputation with Thunder Bluff

96260.dialogueBodyHTML:
Stronger than Steel

Gather 3 strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.
Crystalline Silk (3)

Description

Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me. One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study. Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.

Progress

This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.

Completion

These are excellent samples, and more than sufficient for my needs.

Here, take this. I was able to craft a rather unique cloak with a weave I spun from the small sample of silk already in my possession. I am hopeful that you will find it useful in your travels.

Earthmother watch over you, <class>.

Rewards

You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
Spidersilk Sack Spidersilk Pouch
You will also receive:
Crystal Thread Cloak

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 100 reputation with Earthen Ring
  • 100 reputation with Thunder Bluff

96261.dialogueBodyHTML:
The Broodmother

Kill Broodmother Valraxx at Gloomrise.
  •  
Broodmother Valraxx slain (1)

Description

As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population. If we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.

Progress

Have you destroyed the broodmother, <class>?

Completion

Reanimated dead? The broodmother possessing a night elven form? These are troubling revelations. One has to wonder what it all means... I fear that must be a concern for a later time.

Thank you, <name>. You've done the Earthen Ring and the people of Mulgore a great service.

Rewards

You will receive:
Transformative Cocoon

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator

8: Kill Broodmother Valraxx at Gloomrise.

96294.dialogueBodyHTML:
A Darker Truth

Bring the letter you recovered from Broodmother Valraxx to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.
Bloody Parchment (Provided) (1)

Description

<The Broodmother you just killed is no spider at all, but rather a night elf druid who assumed a twisted animal form. A variety of questions flood your mind about the nature--and purpose--of the spiders at Gloomrise. You notice a note peeking out of the folds of the dead elf's robe. Perhaps this document may answer some of the questions filling your head.>

Progress

What is this?

Completion

This is... most disturbing. Why would a druid be behind a brood of dangerous spiders? Who or what is this "Wild King" and "Pact" that is referenced in this letter?

I will confer with the druids of the Cenarion Circle on this. Perhaps they will know more.

Thank you again for your aid. As disturbing as this information is, we will rest easier knowing that the person controlling these vile creatures has been destroyed.

Rewards

You will receive:

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 100 reputation with Orgrimmar
  • 100 reputation with Earthen Ring
  • 100 reputation with Thunder Bluff

4770.dialogueBodyHTML:
Homeward Bound

Escort Pao'ka Swiftmountain from Highperch, and then talk to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post.

 

Escort Pao'ka from Highperch (1)

Description

Please help me, <class>! I've been hiding here in Highperch for some time now and it's been days since I've seen a friendly face. I came here to study the wyvern and I think I got a little too close. After being chased away from one of the nests I got lost.

I need to get back to Whitereach Post! Motega does not know that I am missing and will be furious to know that I ventured into Highperch by myself.

Whitereach Post is just east of here... please take me there!

Completion

What!? If I knew that Pao'ka Swiftmountain was going to snoop around Highperch, I would have chained him to a totem! His father was reluctant allowing him to come with me to Thousand Needles. We came here to study the different creatures that inhabit these beautiful lands.

I appreciate the help you have shown Pao'ka. I hope this covers any misfortunes this deed has cost you.

Rewards

You will receive:

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 100 reputation with Thunder Bluff

4904.dialogueBodyHTML:
Free at Last

Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.

 

Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle. (1)

Description

Arnak thinks we're going to be married... but after I declined his offer he came back that night and kidnapped me. My brother tried to stop him, but Arnak was too strong. He... he slew my brother and then brought me here. My poor brother...

<name>, could you escort me out of the Darkcloud Pinnacle? Please... I need to get back to Thalia! She must be worried sick about me.

Completion

Thank you, <name>. Deep in my bones I knew that she would find her way back to me. She told me of your bravery and how you helped her escape. These items belonged to her brother. I know she would want you to have them.

Rewards

Windsong Cinch Windsong Drape

WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem

Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.
Arnak's Hoof (1)

Wanted: Arnak Grimtotem

Arnak the outcast is wanted for the heinous crimes of murder and kidnapping. Handsome rewards will be given to those brave enough to bring this criminal to justice.

Arnak was last seen on the cliffs near the Darkcloud Pinnacle. Show the proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post in order to claim the reward.

Have you any news of that murderous Arnak Grimtotem?

Here you are, <name>... and thanks. News of Arnak's foul deeds boiled my blood!

98155.dialogueBodyHTML:
Pristine Pesterhide Pelts

Bring 5 Pristine Pesterhide Pelts to Kristy Grant.
Pristine Pesterhide Pelt (5)

Description

The Pesterhide hyenas of Thousand Needles have the most gorgeous coats. I haven't seen such a brilliant hue of fur like that in all of my travels! I would like to send back some pelts to my sisters back in Stormwind, as I know they could make something incredible out of them. I don't have any fighting experience, so I would be very grateful if you could gather some of the Pesterhide pelts in my stead.

Progress

Were you able to collect the pelts? Rendow has promised to help me clean and tan them to send back home! I know my sisters will be very excited.

Completion

Thank you, <name>! These hides are in perfect condition. I can't imagine it was easy to get so many, but I am very grateful to you for your work.

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 100 reputation with Stormwind

98156.dialogueBodyHTML:
Packaged Pristine Pelts

Bring the Package of Pristine Pelts to Kimberly Grant.
Provided item:
Package of Pristine Pelts (1)

Description

<name>, you have been so helpful to me I hate to ask for yet another favor. It will be some time until I am able to return home to Stormwind. I was wondering if you would mind delivering these pelts to my sisters in my stead? I am sure you are more likely to return there before I am able to. Please deliver these pelts to my sisters Kelly and Kimberly in Stormwind. They can usually be found in the Park.

Completion

This is from our sister? We hadn't heard from her in some time. I hope she is doing well.

My, these pelts have such a beautiful color of fur! Kelly and I will make sure we put these to good use.

Thank you for making the long journey. It is good to know Kristy is still doing well and is thinking of us.

Rewards

You will receive:
Pelt Pants

Gains

  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 100 reputation with Stormwind

567.dialogueBodyHTML:
Dangerous!

High Executor Darthalia of Tarren Mill is offering a bounty on Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, Citizen Wilkes, Miner Hackett and Farmer Kalaba.
  •  
Clerk Horrace Whitesteed slain (1)
  •  
Citizen Wilkes slain (1)
  •  
Miner Hackett slain (1)
  •  
Farmer Kalaba slain (1)

Description

Dangerous!

The following humans of Hillsbrad have been deemed dangerous and are marked for bounty by High Executor Darthalia:

Clerk Horrace Whitesteed. Wanted for the murder of Deathguard Toma.

Citizen Wilkes. Wanted for the murder of Apothecary Eli.

Miner Hackett. Wanted for the murder of Deathstalker Fry.

Farmer Kalaba. Wanted for the ambush of supplies from the Undercity.

All of these enemies are hiding and will be hard to find. A reward will be granted upon notice of their death.

Yes?

You are quite the bounty hunter, <class>.  Well done.

Rewards

Charred Wand
You will also receive:
Hooded Cowl

98059.dialogueBodyHTML:
Hillsbrad's Hoard

Place the Sealed Company Request you were given on the bookkeeping table within Hillsbrad's town hall.
  •  
Sealed Company Request delivered to Hillsbrad council (1)
Provided item:
Sealed Company Request (1)

Description

Hillsbrad's council hasn't answered our new magistrate's letters. The last word I pried out of a passing merchant from the town did little to justify their silence. We're only asking for a small platoon--yet I'm told multiple siege ballista rest in pristine condition within a walled-off compound. Walk into their town hall like a citizen returning a census request, and place this neatly upon the bookkeeping table. Return to me when the deed is done.

Completion

Good work, soldier. I know you're not stationed with us, but we never turn away capable hands.

If they don't respond to THIS letter, we'll have to be more crude in our messaging.

We'll keep you on reserve for civilian interactions should the need arise again.

Rewards

You will receive:

  • Open in Experience Calculator

98071.dialogueBodyHTML:
Brewer's Trade

Deliver the bottles of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in southeast Hillsbrad Foothills, and bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops.
  •  
Fallrook Varietal delivered to Dun Garok (1)
Sack of Homebrew Hops (1)
Provided item:
Case of Fallrook Varietal (1)

Description

Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars. Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort. In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye. That keep is the closest thing to home around here!

Progress

Lookin' ta try a new ale?

Completion

That's the hops smell I missed! Ye done me a great favor, <name>, takes me days to leave every time I make the trip to Dun Garok myself. Hard to pull me self outta the halls o' that fortress once I get comfortable.

Happy to keep some old tastes on the shelf for fellow dwarves.

Have a little somethin' for helpin out.

Rewards

You will receive:
Brewer's Bracers

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator

6504.dialogueBodyHTML:
The Lost Pages

Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.
Shredder Operating Manual - Chapter 1 (1)
Shredder Operating Manual - Chapter 2 (1)
Shredder Operating Manual - Chapter 3 (1)

Description

I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.

The pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?

Progress

I hope you find the pages soon, <name>! I really need to get back to work!

Completion

Reading isn't my strong point... but now I'll be able to get back to work! Thanks, <name>!

Rewards

You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
Shredder Operating Gloves Oilrag Handwraps

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 100 reputation with Orgrimmar

6921.dialogueBodyHTML:
Amongst the Ruins

Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
Fathom Core (1)

Description

The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us. If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.

<name>, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water. In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity. If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!

Progress

Have you been successful in locating the fathom core?  Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.

Completion

This is exactly what I need!  A fathom core is an incredible well of information that we will be able to draw much good from.  Whatever the Twilight's Hammer is up to in there - and believe me when I say it is no good - my comrades and I will now uncover.

You've done well here today; the Earthen Ring looks upon you warmly for assisting us.  You've also helped the Horde as a whole, and for that you should be proud.

Rewards

You will receive:

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 150 reputation with Darkspear Trolls
  • 150 reputation with Earthen Ring
See if you've already completed this by typing:
/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(6921))

6922.dialogueBodyHTML:
Baron Aquanis

Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
Strange Water Globe (Provided) (1)

Description

The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe. You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy. Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about. The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.

If anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring. He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.

Progress

Ah, hello again <name>.  I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do.  What brings you to the outpost?

Completion

This... this is quite the find, <name>.

You acquired this from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom, you say?  Baron Aquanis has long been thought of as a corrupted elemental power; this globe will prove what exactly had corrupted him.  While it would be no surprise if it turned out to be the Twilight's Hammer, our studies will also show how they did it as well.

You did well in bringing this to me.  Please - take this, along with the Earthen Ring's warmest regards.

Rewards

You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
Outlaw Sabre Witch's Finger
Dreamer's Chestguard

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 150 reputation with Darkspear Trolls
See if you've already completed this by typing:
/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(6922))

1153.dialogueBodyHTML:
A New Ore Sample

Find an Unrefined Ore Sample on a Gravelsnout Digger or Surveyor and bring it to Tatternack Steelforge at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
Unrefined Ore Sample (1)

Description

<class>, you have done well in helping me in the past. The warchief is pleased thus far with what I've accomplished, and asks me to continue with renewed determination. My honor dictates that I give you proper recognition to the warchief for all you have done, but first I would ask you for your help again.

Travelers recently came from the south from a place called Thousand Needles. There they killed a kobold who had an unusual ore sample, but they would not sell it. I want a sample of that ore to examine.

Progress

I saw the travelers again--the ones that would not sell me a sample of the ore. I spit at them for not helping the warchief.

May they die in battle like cowards and not like warriors as should be the right of all people who ally themselves with the Horde.

Completion

A good sample, <name>. A good sample indeed.

Those travelers can no longer lord over me the ore they found, now that you have been successful.

I shall get to work on it immediately. If it proves strong enough, I will send a weapon crafted from the material back to the warchief to show him our success.

I shall not forget your help, <class>.

Rewards

You will receive:
Orcish War Sword

Gains

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
  • Open in Experience Calculator
  • 100 reputation with Orgrimmar
